dedupe_keys.name: city of melbourne development activity monitor

description: City of Melbourne publishes the monitor of major new commercial and residential property development in the municipality, listing development sites that are recently completed, under construction, planned or mooted in the 13 small areas of the city, with status, year completed, block, address, property identifiers, floors above ground and dwelling counts by bedroom number. Coverage: the City of Melbourne municipality, Australia; about 1,450 records, record last modified on 2026-09-24. Format and access: CSV, JSON, GeoJSON, downloadable without registration from the City of Melbourne open data portal. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): CC BY; cost: free. Caveats: it covers major developments only, not every building; the full field definitions are in an attached document that was not read. Simulation uses: short- to medium-term supply forecasts of floor space and dwellings, and growth scenarios for demand on transport, water and energy networks. Related catalogue records: other layers and datasets of the same portal in this catalogue are contextual companions.
